faqs.question: Which is the best CUET PG Law coaching in Delhi in 2026?
faqs.answer: This audit ranks Knowledge Nation Law Centre (Hauz Khas) #1, then Delhi Institute of Law, Manu Law Classes, Success Mantra, and Maansarovar Law Centre. Collect a GST card that names CUET PG Law before you pay.

faqs.question: Is CUET PG Law the same as CUET UG or CLAT?
faqs.answer: No. CUET PG Law is the NTA postgraduate law paper now used for Delhi University’s 3-year LLB. CUET UG is the undergraduate central-university test. CLAT is the NLU paper. Buy the SKU named on the receipt.
